scope: One pretrained C05 seed-99 checkpoint. Frozen-source readout consolidation and all-observed landmark control in the full DMLab level. No new representation learning, no 100M training matrix, no cross-donor replication claim.

organization.requires_before_submission: Promote this reviewed draft into a versioned analysis sidecar with a focused validator; bind the immutable validated donor StudySpec and its SHA. Render collection, fit and source-sharded evaluation commands from this one plan.
organization.existing_contract_incompatibility: intrmotiv/study/v1 requires training/bases/factors/seeds and renders Cartesian Sample Factory or supplemental-argument RunSpecs. The present dependency chain is one frozen replay collection, one offline fit, and four read-only matched evaluators consuming artifact hashes. It is not four or six independent SF training runs.
organization.minimal_integration: Retain canonical donor selection, manifest schema, source archives, workspace checks, ordinary Slurm jobs and telemetry postprocessors. Add only an analysis-plan adapter/validation for the dependency chain; do not fabricate SF RunSpecs or mutate the donor StudySpec.

prerequisites: Qualification job completes all integration gates; review actual runtime and hashes, not queue state.
Main protocol and immutable source release reviewed before submission; edits after freezing require a new release and source receipt.
Original checkpoint/config/decoder and five actions with repeat8 remain exact; collector/evaluator override parity and runfiles identity required.

collection.behavior: Existing frozen source policy sampled normally on its 80% branch, uniform among the same five actions on the 20% branch; record actual branch and action counts.
collection.encoder_ca3_manager_graph_and_bn: Frozen weights and persistent buffers; ordinary recurrent state evolves within episodes. Fresh initial recurrent state at genuine resets.
collection.reward: Verify every native reward finite and zero before shaping. No external reward labels, no goal reward adaptation of the source.
collection.transport: Factual core/action/true successor pairing; physical terminals require certified final DG or successor_valid=false. Never insert reset DG as terminal successor.
collection.coverage: Report winner and exclusive counts for every DG identity0..15, all five action counts, missing successor count and fraction, episode count and durations. Landmark-by-action support is descriptive, not certification of support at every CA3 history.

fit.target: Same-goal finite-deadline Double-Q first-hit target; success before physical done, deadline decrements, h0=0, all16 factual labels including negatives.
fit.trainable: Copied actual pretrained legacy MlpDecoderJit and new existing deadline auxiliary Q head only. Original PPO actor, DG/BN, CA3 update, graph and goal manager unchanged.
fit.deadline_sampling: Uniform integer h in1..256 for each sampled factual transition.
fit.selection: Final weights at exactly30000 updates. Episode-level 10% holdout and logged TD residuals are diagnostic only; no early stopping or checkpoint/hyperparameter selection.
fit.resource_note: Use100-update qualification timing solely to reserve walltime and memory. Do not change the scientific update budget in response to performance.
fit.finite_h_propagation: Exact tabular synchronous first-hit iteration needs up toH Bellman layers from zero to propagate a lengthH path.300 target refreshes provide more than256 opportunities, not a convergence proof: replay coverage, neural approximation, simultaneous h sampling, Double-Q action choice, and affine deadline interactions can still fail.
fit.saturation_diagnostics: Report TD residual by h bins1..16,17..32,33..64,65..128,129..256 and predicted ranges; where no certified heldout transitions exist, report missing. Small self-bootstrapped TD error alone is not calibrated reachability.

evaluation.targets: Every identity observed by immutable source graph counts, factual replay, or independent discovery; no passive-edge filter or arbitrary subset. Report all16 capacity identities, including unseen/unissued as unassessed.
evaluation.cost_formula: 96*512 discovery +4sources*3histories*16commands*2policies*(512prefix+256trial)=344064 per shard. Early own-hit stopping reduces actual cost; matched blocks are reserved before execution.
evaluation.matched_protocol: For every retained source history, replay identical fresh-engine seed, physical prefix and recurrent state for source PPO argmax and fitted Q argmax, each requested goal and H256. Exact observation/state signatures and full model/graph/Q hashes must match. No evaluation updates.
evaluation.controls: Execute every alternative command from the same start under each actor, then score each requested target on those actual paths. This supplies shuffled-command controls without retrospective relabeling of a single command or an extra stochastic policy factor.
evaluation.stop: Own primary winner hit is absorbing, including t0. Alternative target arrival counts only through that stop. Exclude already-achieved evaluated targets from nontrivial success and already-achieved alternate commands from paired lift, while retaining all declared rows.
evaluation.primary_detector: Actual processed core DG in CA3 slot0, positive argmax winner; not raw visual-head DG.
evaluation.secondary_detector: Exclusive single-positive event on the same primary-stopped trajectory; not a separately stopped exclusive policy.
evaluation.deadline_curve_scope: Read time-to-hit from fixed H256-policy trials. These are cumulative-arrival curves, not policies optimized separately for shorter deadlines.

complete_16_goal_denominators.notes: These totals assume all16 source starts and target identities exist. Missing histories remain declared. Unseen targets stay in a capacity16 table with unissued/unassessed labels and success identification bounds; do not call them empirically unreachable.

evaluation.terminal_caveat: Current qualification callback discards certified final-observation infos; its unresolved physical boundaries are censored. Keep all issued/missing/censored denominators, success lower/upper bounds and paired-lift identification interval. R2 may transport certified final DG compatibly; absent that, do not call complete-case estimates full success probabilities.
evaluation.uncertainty: Trials across goals and alternate commands share each history. Cluster paired contrasts by source identity (all3histories and allgoals together),10000 bootstrap replicates, seed123,95% interval; treat inference as conditional on one donor and this start-generation procedure, not training-seed replication.

primary_estimands: Goal-macro-average commanded first-hit probability and per-goal rates with full declared missing/censor bounds.
Paired fitted-Q minus source-PPO commanded success on identical starts.
Paired own-command minus executed-alternative arrival lift, including censor identification bounds.
Worst goal and full source-by-goal matrices, time-to-first-hit, failures, unknowns and initial command action changes.
interpretation.positive_mechanism_evidence: Fitted readout improves paired commanded arrivals over original PPO and has positive own-versus-alternate lift after censor uncertainty; report intervals and every goal, not only averages. This supports the minimal objective/acting change for this frozen representation.
interpretation.all_goal_capability_gate: Suggested stringent descriptive qualification: all16 identities must be observed and issued, no missing source-history cells, and each goal has commanded-success lower bound at least0.90 across its45 noninitial source histories plus positive command lift. Otherwise label partial capability rather than arbitrary-subgoal success. This gate is not a proof for untested histories, unreachable targets or other donors.
interpretation.negative_with_missing_support: Absent goal events, unobserved action/history support, missing starts or material terminal censoring leave that part unassessed; no failure claim for the Bellman objective follows.
interpretation.negative_with_coverage: If replay covers observed goals but execution fails, distinguish optimization/approximation error, off-policy support, memory aliasing/expiry and nondiscriminative detectors using diagnostics. Low heldout self-bootstrapped residual is not an independent oracle.
interpretation.limits: Single pretrained donor and one fitted initialization. DG commands specify detector sets, which may have multiple physical lobes; successful all-observed tests do not establish arbitrary physical coordinates or a universal guarantee.

common_panel_coverage.scope: Fixed shared recorded observation/action history; no new native environment required for representation reuse.

compatibility_and_remote_checks: Existing common-panel receipt explicitly binds exact selected checkpoint SHA; DG reference NPZ byte hash and recorded panel hash are available. Check those remote bytes before reuse.

Verify current source config and image normalization/threshold settings match archived replay metadata; whole-checkpoint identity alone is not an input-normalization certificate. Replaying the existing panel under the frozen source is an environment-free check if metadata is incomplete.

Policy-specific10k fields have exact run/checkpoint frame rows plus original five-age trajectory and terminal seeds8,99,123; raw NPZ checksums/frozen source metadata must be audited before treating their current files as certified.
Online graph/trajectory summaries are training-window evidence; keep them separate from frozen-policy probes and new executed command trials.
The common-panel archive uses x_y occupancy and replay uses y_x; use canonical geometry/axis metadata, not hardcoded image transposes.
existing_evidence.reuse_decision: Reuse exact common-panel maps/pre-threshold maps and compatible existing source-policy10k maps; do not repeat a checkpoint sweep merely because the controller readout changed. Frozen DG map differences under new behavior are sampling/expression effects, not representation learning.

completion_evidence.place_fields: Link both original policy-driven and fixed common-panel maps with silence, active cosine, unique peaks, mono-field components, occupancy support and amplitude-weighted spatial score. Reuse existing seed99 age course and terminal8/123 as source-history context, not replicated new-readout results.
completion_evidence.trajectories: Qualification rows record actions but no per-decision pose. R2 extension required: record position/rotation, episode/segment ID, current detector, commanded goal, remaining horizon and policy at every executed decision, with reset/terminal masks. Privileged pose is telemetry only and must never enter encoder/Q inputs. Reuse canonical pose and plotting helpers.
completion_evidence.graphs: Reuse frozen directed source graph state and existing complete edge tables, separately show all240 source-target execution estimates for source and fitted readout with missing/attempt counts. Replay co-occurrence, stored confidence, historical prospective hits and matched-command first-hit success must remain distinct.
completion_evidence.control: Full per-goal/per-history own and alternative outcome matrices, early-stop semantics, actual actions, initial-action changes, event exposure, complete denominators and time-to-hit curves. Use the same fixed maps to annotate physical arrival footprint as a secondary measure only where mapped support exists.
completion_evidence.physical_secondary: Predefine each learned goal footprint from the archived frozen common-panel DG map before seeing new trial outcomes, retaining all connected components and overlap. Use fixed canonical field threshold/geometry metadata. Report initial-inside, unvisited and overlapping footprint cases; do not rename detector goals unique physical destinations.

minimal_new_field_manifest_if_reuse_fail.policy: Original frozen source stochastic policy, standard protocol
minimal_new_field_manifest_if_reuse_fail.submission: Print-only review via existing submit_place_field_sweep.py; one independent sbatch job only after reuse audit identifies a missing required artifact. No automatic replacement sweep.
minimal_new_field_manifest_if_reuse_fail.note: No new checkpoint-age series is needed for an unchanged fixed donor; map_stability reuses existing five-age artifacts.

release_gaps: Promote and validate analysis sidecar/command renderer; do not mislabel as validated StudySpec.
R2 pose/path telemetry extension and focused tests required for full geometric trajectory analysis; frozen r1 files remain untouched.
Remote raw-artifact/config compatibility audit before representation reuse.
Explicit final summary includes unobserved target capacity denominator; current r1 rows directly enumerate only observed targets.
Qualification full success/missing/censor/source-hash results must be reviewed before main jobs are submitted.
